description: The rows of his day her answer is about, on the answer's `surface.response_emitted` payload and on her row of `GET /inherent/conversation`; absent when there are none. At most 3, in her order. `kind` `row` is an item or span id of `GET /inherent/day` for `date`; `outing` is an outing id of `GET /inherent/footprint` for `date`. `start_ms` and `end_ms` are always set (a row still going ends at the time it was read): when the id is no longer on the page, open the row covering `start_ms`. `title` is at most 20 characters, in his language as she wrote it.
